synopsis: ISO 19206-2:2018 specifies the pedestrian dummy used in UN R131 and Euro NCAP testing, while ISO 19206-4:2020 specifies the bicyclist target [f15324]. Chapter 3 states that Euro NCAP’s 2026–2028 pedestrian targets follow ISO 19206-2:2018, consistent with the glossary’s broader reference to Parts 2 and 4 [f2546, f13500]. UN R131 requires a child pedestrian target conforming to ISO 19206-2 and crossing at 5 km/h; the glossary identifies heavy trucks as the application and separately attributes the target requirement to the 02 series [f2522, f15120, f15397]. These facts establish on-road target requirements, but do not establish their applicability to heavy off-road machines [f2522, f2546, f15120, f15397].

relations.note: Both require an ISO 19206-2 child pedestrian target crossing at 5 km/h.
Identifies the 02 series as requiring the conforming child target.
